name: Nowlert CE Self-Hosted Infrastructure Notifications
free_limit: Free MIT-licensed self-hosted Community Edition for receiving SMTP, authenticated HTTP webhook and Redfish infrastructure events, normalizing and routing notifications to Discord, Teams, Slack, generic webhooks, MQTT and ntfy; no vendor software usage quota or expiry stated.
watch_out: Requires your own Docker host, persistent SQLite storage and secure event ingress. External notification destinations and infrastructure can have separate limits or charges. Community Edition is not a free hosted notification service; verify destination credentials and routing before production use.
